role: Risk-department proposal, decision-committee ratification and runtime enforcement of company-wide aggregate risk requirements after all strategy-level mandates.
invariants: the risk department proposes company policy, the decision committee ratifies it, and runtime risk enforcement does not require a new vote each turn
company risk runs after every strategy-level mandate and evaluates aggregate company exposure
the company risk layer can preserve or reduce an input target but can never create a direction, enlarge absolute intent, or cross through zero
market position limits, market execution capacity, contract trading status, and settlement rules remain harder than company preferences
all volatility and liquidity estimates use information visible at the decision cutoff
drawdown scaling is continuous and risk-scale recovery is capped per half-month when prior state is supplied
reduce-only state never increases absolute exposure
the same seed and candidate index generate the same appointment, radar, proposal and profile hash
players appoint a generated CRO profile and do not submit arbitrary radar values through the service API
the risk layer never writes back to market, forecast, macro, public volume, or open interest
